When compensation was not paid due to [COMPANY_A]'s insufficient financial resources, [PERSON_E] and the victims applied for the commencement of compulsory auctions against [VEHICLE_GROUP_A] and [VEHICLE_GROUP_B] owned by [COMPANY_A], and [VEHICLE_GROUP_A] was seized. [COMPANY_B] entered into an agreement with the victims and paid the victims a total of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A], and the victims agreed to waive their remaining claims regarding delay damages and other matters, their claims for litigation costs, and all claims against [COMPANY_A].

neutral_fact_en: [ORGANIZATION_A] purchased shipping documents from [COMPANY_C] and, at that time, entered into an export bill insurance contract with [INSTITUTION_A] to secure payment of the export proceeds, but did not receive collateral from [COMPANY_C]. In bill-of-exchange transactions under documents-against-acceptance terms, the importer could receive the shipping documents and take delivery of the goods simply by accepting the bill of exchange, and whether the bill of exchange would be duly paid depended on the importer's willingness and ability to pay. [ORGANIZATION_A] provided foreign-exchange loans to [COMPANY_C] by purchasing bills of exchange secured by bills of lading, and purchased, without receiving collateral, bills of exchange issued under documents-against-acceptance terms and the shipping documents. At [COMPANY_C]'s request, [ORGANIZATION_A] changed the acceptor of the bill of exchange from the original importer to [COMPANY_B]. [ORGANIZATION_A] did not receive payment of the export proceeds from [COMPANY_B], claimed insurance proceeds from [INSTITUTION_A], but did not receive the insurance proceeds either, and therefore failed to recover an amount equivalent to the export proceeds. The fact that [ORGANIZATION_A] purchased the bills of exchange and shipping documents without collateral and changed the acceptor of the bills of exchange became one of the causes of the circumstances in which [ORGANIZATION_A] did not receive the insurance proceeds and failed to recover an amount equivalent to the export proceeds. While already delinquent on its foreign-exchange loan debt to [ORGANIZATION_A], [COMPANY_C] suddenly made many requests to purchase shipping documents under documents-against-acceptance terms, and the export unit prices on the export declarations were excessively high compared with the average export unit prices. [COMPANY_A] alleged that the president of [COMPANY_B], when accepting on December 19, 1996 bills of exchange on which he was designated as the payer, received from [BANK_A] the shipping documents, including the bills of lading, and was in possession of the bills of lading at the time the goods were delivered.
neutral_fact_ko: [ORGANIZATION_A]는 [COMPANY_C]로부터 선적서류를 매입했고, 그 당시 수출대금 지급을 확보하기 위해 [INSTITUTION_A]와 수출어음보험계약을 체결했으나 [COMPANY_C]로부터 담보를 제공받지 않았다. 인수도 조건의 환어음거래에서는 수입자가 환어음을 단순히 인수해도 선적서류를 받아 물품을 인도받을 수 있었고, 환어음의 정상 결제 여부는 수입자의 지급 의사와 자력에 달려 있었다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 [COMPANY_C]로부터 선하증권을 담보로 환어음을 매입하는 방식으로 외환대출을 했고, 담보를 받지 않은 상태에서 인수도 조건으로 발행된 환어음과 선적서류를 매입했다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 [COMPANY_C]의 요청에 따라 환어음 인수인을 원래의 수입자에서 [COMPANY_B]로 변경했다. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 [COMPANY_B]로부터 수출대금을 지급받지 못했고, [INSTITUTION_A]에 보험금을 청구했으나 보험금도 지급받지 못해 수출대금 상당액을 회수하지 못했다. [ORGANIZATION_A]가 담보 없이 환어음과 선적서류를 매입하고 환어음 인수인을 변경한 일은 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 보험금을 지급받지 못하고 수출대금 상당액을 회수하지 못한 경위의 한 원인이 되었다. [COMPANY_C]는 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 대한 외환대출채무를 이미 연체한 상태에서 인수도 조건에 따른 선적서류 매입을 갑자기 많이 요청했고, 수출신고필증의 수출단가는 평균적인 수출단가보다 지나치게 높았다. [COMPANY_A]는 [COMPANY_B]의 사장이 1996년 12월 19일 자신이 지급인으로 된 환어음을 인수하면서 [BANK_A]로부터 선하증권을 포함한 선적서류를 인도받아 운송물 인도 당시 선하증권을 소지하고 있었다고 주장했다.

neutral_fact_en: After confirming a request to supply goods from [INSTITUTION_A](public institution), [ORGANIZATION_A] allocated some of the goods to its members and handled its operations by supplying the members with raw materials purchased from raw-material suppliers, so that the members manufactured finished products and delivered them to [INSTITUTION_A](public institution). [ORGANIZATION_A] could secure its claim for the raw-material price by preventing the raw materials supplied to its members from being used for purposes other than delivery to [INSTITUTION_A](public institution), receiving the price of the goods directly from [INSTITUTION_A](public institution), and then paying the members the amount remaining after deducting the raw-material price and commission. [ORGANIZATION_A] was established with approximately 130 nationwide companies producing wire-mesh products as its members and had the joint sale of wire-mesh products and joint purchase of raw materials as its primary operations for the benefit of its members. [PERSON_A] worked as the executive director of [ORGANIZATION_A] from approximately April 1988 through February 27, 2002. [ORGANIZATION_A] ordinarily purchased and supplied to its members only raw materials equivalent to 60% of the goods supply price to [INSTITUTION_A](public institution). From February 23, 1999, through June 26, 2001, [PERSON_A] allocated goods to [COMPANY_A]. Before allocating goods to [COMPANY_A], [PERSON_A] ordered raw materials and ordered a quantity exceeding 60% of [COMPANY_A]'s allocation amount, thereby causing [COMPANY_A] to receive raw materials worth [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]. [ORGANIZATION_A] failed to recover [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] of the price of the raw materials supplied to [COMPANY_A]. After pre-supplying large quantities of raw materials to [COMPANY_A] over an extended period without having received a delivery notification from [INSTITUTION_A], [ORGANIZATION_A] failed to recover [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] of the price of the raw materials supplied. In approximately 1999, it was not the case that [LOCATION_A] planned to order gabions in connection with a flood-damage restoration project and then changed the design to revetment blocks. Of the gabions delivered to [LOCATION_A] in 1999, the quantity delivered by [ORGANIZATION_A] was worth approximately [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_D], and the remainder was delivered by companies other than [COMPANY_A]. [LOCATION_A] did not enter into a gabion delivery contract in 2000. The total amount of raw materials supplied to [COMPANY_A] exceeded the total post hoc goods allocation amount of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_C].
neutral_fact_ko: [ORGANIZATION_A]은(는) [INSTITUTION_A](공공기관)으로부터 물품공급요청을 확인한 뒤 조합원에게 물품 일부를 배정하고, 원자재공급업체로부터 구매한 원자재를 해당 조합원에게 공급하여 조합원이 완제품을 제작해 [INSTITUTION_A](공공기관)에 납품하는 방식으로 업무를 처리해 왔다. [ORGANIZATION_A]은(는) 조합원에게 공급한 원자재가 [INSTITUTION_A](공공기관)에 대한 납품용이 아닌 다른 용도로 사용되는 것을 방지하고, [INSTITUTION_A](공공기관)으로부터 직접 물품대금을 지급받은 뒤 원자재대금과 수수료를 공제한 금액을 조합원에게 지급하는 방식으로 원자재대금 채권을 확보할 수 있었다. [ORGANIZATION_A]은(는) 철망제품을 생산하는 전국 약 130개 업체를 조합원으로 하여 설립되었고, 조합원들의 이익을 위해 철망제품 공동판매와 원자재 공동구매를 주된 업무로 하였다. [PERSON_A]은(는) 1988년 4월경부터 2002년 2월 27일까지 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 전무이사로 근무하였다. [ORGANIZATION_A]은(는) 통상적으로 [INSTITUTION_A](공공기관)에 대한 물품공급가액의 60%에 상당한 원자재만을 구매하여 조합원에게 공급하였다. 1999년 2월 23일부터 2001년 6월 26일까지 [PERSON_A]은(는) [COMPANY_A]에 물품을 배정하였다. neutral_fact_en: A non-self-propelled barge, [VEHICLE_B], owned by [COMPANY_C], was towed after being connected to the stern of [VEHICLE_A] by a rope approximately 300 m long; [VEHICLE_B] was carrying the deckhouse of a vessel under construction and three empty containers, and [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B], employees of [COMPANY_C], were aboard. After departure, fog repeatedly became dense and then thinned around the route, and from around 22:00 on 2006. 7. 12., the fog became dense and visibility was limited to approximately less than 15 m. Even while visibility was limited to approximately less than 15 m, [VEHICLE_A] continued navigating without sounding its whistle. [PERSON_C] detected [VEHICLE_C] navigating at a distance of approximately 9.26 km by radar, but continued navigating as it was, having incorrectly judged that [VEHICLE_C] would safely cross approximately 3.70–5.56 km ahead of [VEHICLE_A]'s bow. At around 03:35 on 2006. 13., as [VEHICLE_C] approached from ahead, [VEHICLE_A], sensing a risk of collision, changed direction to avoid [VEHICLE_C], but the forward end of the towed [VEHICLE_B] collided with the left side of [VEHICLE_C]. While visibility was extremely limited by dense fog, the captain of [VEHICLE_C], [PERSON_D], operated [VEHICLE_C] while neglecting radar lookout for surrounding vessels and without sounding the whistle. As a result of the collision, [VEHICLE_C] capsized, and seven crew members, including captain [PERSON_D], went missing and died; crew member [PERSON_F] was rescued with injuries including hypoxic encephalopathy. Immediately before the collision, [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B], who were aboard [VEHICLE_B], were sleeping in the cabin and fell from their beds onto the deck at the moment of the collision. According to [PERSON_A]'s testimony, after inspecting the hull of [VEHICLE_B], [PERSON_A] discovered signs of the collision, informed [VEHICLE_A]'s navigator, [PERSON_C], of that fact, and demanded that [PERSON_C] wake [VEHICLE_A]'s captain and report it; however, [PERSON_C] ignored the report, took no subsequent action, and continued navigating. At the time of the collision, [VEHICLE_B] was not equipped with facilities such as a whistle or siren capable of emitting sound signals, and it did not display sidelights or a sternlight. It was determined that [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] had boarded to manage the cargo and had not boarded to assist in navigating [VEHICLE_A]. It was recognized that, although visibility was extremely poor because of the fog, if [VEHICLE_B]'s side had properly made sound and light signals, there was a substantial likelihood that [VEHICLE_C]'s side would have noticed the presence of [VEHICLE_B] and prevented the collision by slowing down or changing direction in advance. It was recognized that, because [VEHICLE_B]'s side made no sound or light signals, [VEHICLE_C]'s side did not notice the presence of [VEHICLE_B] and, as a result, failed to prevent the collision by slowing down or changing direction in advance.
neutral_fact_ko: [COMPANY_C] 소유의 자력 항행능력이 없는 부선인 [VEHICLE_B]를 길이 약 300m의 밧줄로 [VEHICLE_A]의 선미에 연결하여 예인했고, [VEHICLE_B]에는 건조 중인 선박의 갑판실과 빈 컨테이너 3개가 실려 있었으며 [COMPANY_C]의 직원인 [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]가 승선했다. 출항 후 항로 주변에는 안개가 반복적으로 짙어졌다가 옅어졌고, 2006. 7. 12. 22:00경부터는 안개가 짙어져 시계가 약 15m 미만으로 제한되었다. 시계가 약 15m 미만으로 제한된 상태에서도 [VEHICLE_A]는 기적을 울리지 않은 채 항해를 계속했고, [PERSON_C]은 레이더로 약 9.26km 거리에서 항해하는 [VEHICLE_C]를 발견했으나 [VEHICLE_C]가 [VEHICLE_A]의 선수 전방 약 3.70~5.56km 거리를 두고 안전하게 횡단할 것이라고 잘못 판단한 채 그대로 항해했다. 2006. 13. 03:35경 [VEHICLE_C]가 선수 전방에서 접근하자 충돌 위험을 느낀 [VEHICLE_A]가 방향을 변경하여 [VEHICLE_C]를 피했으나, 예인되던 [VEHICLE_B]의 앞머리와 [VEHICLE_C]의 왼쪽 부분이 서로 충돌했다. 짙은 안개로 시계가 극도로 제한된 상태에서 [VEHICLE_C]의 선장 [PERSON_D]는 주변 선박에 대한 레이더 경계를 소홀히 하고 기적도 울리지 않은 채 [VEHICLE_C]를 운항했다. 이 충돌로 [VEHICLE_C]가 전복되었고, 선장 [PERSON_D]를 포함한 선원 7명이 실종되어 사망했으며, 선원 [PERSON_F]은 저산소성 뇌병증 등의 상해를 입은 채 구조되었다. 충돌 직전 [VEHICLE_B]에 승선한 [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]는 선실에서 잠을 자고 있었고, 충돌 순간 침대에서 떨어져 갑판으로 나왔다. [PERSON_A]는 [VEHICLE_B]의 선체를 점검한 뒤 충돌 흔적을 발견하고 그 사실을 [VEHICLE_A]의 항해사 [PERSON_C]에게 알리면서 [VEHICLE_A]의 선장을 깨워 보고해 달라고 요구했으나, [PERSON_C]은 그 보고를 무시하고 사후 조치를 하지 않은 채 계속 항해했다. 충돌 당시 [VEHICLE_B]에는 음향신호를 내보낼 수 있는 기적이나 사이렌 등의 시설이 장착되어 있지 않았고, 현등 및 선미등을 밝히지 않았다. [PERSON_A]와 [PERSON_B]는 화물을 관리하기 위해 승선했으며, [VEHICLE_A]의 항해를 보조하기 위해 승선한 것은 아니라는 판단이 있었다. 안개로 시계가 극히 불량했지만, [VEHICLE_B] 측에서 음향신호와 등화신호를 제대로 했다면 [VEHICLE_C] 측이 [VEHICLE_B]의 존재를 알아채고 사전에 감속하거나 방향을 변경하여 충돌을 방지했을 개연성이 상당하다고 인정되었다. [VEHICLE_B] 측의 음향신호와 등화신호가 없었기 때문에 [VEHICLE_C] 측이 [VEHICLE_B]의 존재를 알아채지 못했고, 그 결과 사전 감속이나 방향 변경을 하지 못해 충돌을 방지하지 못했을 개연성이 상당하다고 인정되었다.

[PERSON_A] and two passengers in [VEHICLE_A] died, and [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C], who were other passengers in [VEHICLE_A], as well as the driver and 14 passengers of the injured [VEHICLE_B], were injured. Under the insurance contract, [COMPANY_A] paid the insurance benefits under the automobile injury rider to [PERSON_A]'s heirs and [PERSON_B], and paid compulsory liability insurance benefits under bodily injury liability coverage to the other victims. The court of first instance determined that the road at the accident location lacked road safety facilities, such as road-surface markings and visual guidance signs proportionate to the danger, and therefore was in a condition that lacked ordinary safety. The court of first instance determined that the condition in which the road safety facilities lacked ordinary safety was one cause of the occurrence and expansion of the damage caused by the accident.

neutral_fact_en: Immediately after [PERSON_A]'s accident, [ORGANIZATION_B] announced an investigation result that [PERSON_A] had committed suicide. [ORGANIZATION_C] investigated the accident beginning around 2000 and announced investigation results on August 20, 2002, and September 10, 2002, that [PERSON_A] had been killed by another person. [ORGANIZATION_D] began a reinvestigation on August 26, 2002, and announced an investigation result on November 28, 2002, that [PERSON_A] had committed suicide. As the initial investigation result was maintained, [PERSON_A]'s family effectively had no opportunity for more than 16 years to learn the cause and circumstances of [PERSON_A]'s death, until [ORGANIZATION_C]'s investigation began in 2000. While several state agencies conducted overlapping investigations over an extended period and announced differing investigation results, the mental suffering experienced by [PERSON_A]'s family appears to have been greater than that experienced in other ordinary similar incidents. There was drinking and disturbance at [ORGANIZATION_B]'s barracks in the early hours of the day of the accident, but [ORGANIZATION_B] did not investigate their relevance to the accident. Not enough scene photographs were attached to the investigation records to determine whether bloodstains, bone fragments, or brain tissue were scattered at the scene. During the autopsy, [PERSON_A]'s left-hand wound was not incised to determine whether there was subcutaneous bleeding, and the stomach contents were not analyzed to investigate the estimated time of death. In addition, [ORGANIZATION_B] did not investigate whether the firearm had bloodstains or soil on it, or record the results. Although [PERSON_A] had three gunshot wounds, only two cartridge cases were initially found at the scene, and the timing and circumstances of the discovery of one additional cartridge case were not explained. The serial number of the rifle at the scene was typed and then altered by hand, but there was no explanation, and although the examination result stated that the firing marks on the three cartridge cases were identical, only a photograph of one cartridge case was attached. It has not been clearly established to date whether [PERSON_A]'s cause of death was homicide or suicide, and [PERSON_C] and [PERSON_D] experienced mental suffering as a result. If the necessary investigative measures had been carried out, it might have been possible to determine the cause of [PERSON_A]'s death, but because those measures were not carried out, it has remained impossible to reach a clear conclusion to date as to whether it was homicide or suicide. [PERSON_C] and [PERSON_D] experienced mental suffering because they were effectively deprived of the opportunity, or any reasonable expectation, to ascertain the truth of the fatal accident. [PERSON_H], a member of the unit to which [PERSON_A] belonged, testified that bone fragments were scattered within 30 cm to 1 m in front of [PERSON_A]'s head. The autopsy doctor, [PERSON_I], testified that 300–400 mL of blood had pooled inside the left chest cavity of [PERSON_A], and that this was an amount that could not flow after the heart had stopped.

neutral_fact_en: [PERSON_A] and four others, as landowners, raised a dispute concerning the compensation appraisal against [COMPANY_A] and two others. [COMPANY_B] and [COMPANY_C] selected [LOCATION_A] building site, 215㎡, as the comparison standard land for the land listed as No. 7, and [LOCATION_B] paddy field, 1,024㎡, as the comparison standard land for the lands listed as Nos. 8 and 9. [COMPANY_A] also selected [LOCATION_B] paddy field, 1,024㎡, as the comparison standard land for the land listed as No. 9. [COMPANY_A] and the other appraisal businesses conducted appraisals by examining the actual conditions of the land and its surrounding environment and analyzing the regional factors and individual factors in comparison with the comparison standard land. [COMPANY_A] determined that the area adjacent to the land listed as No. 9 was an area of potential residential land between a road and a river, and viewed the opposite side as having apartment complexes and existing residential areas formed there, with subway construction underway. [LOCATION_B] paddy field, 1,024㎡, had been publicly announced since 1992 as land whose actual land category was a recreation area and which adjoined on one side a road at least 25 m wide, and was the site of [PROPERTY_A], which had previously been used as a swimming pool. [PERSON_A] claimed that [COMPANY_A] had conducted an appraisal contrary to the actual conditions of the land and that [PERSON_A] had suffered loss corresponding to the difference between the appropriate loss-compensation price and the actual compensation amount. Of the 453㎡ of [LOCATION_C] building site near the lands listed as Nos. 1 through 6, 354㎡ was purchased by agreement around January 1996, and [LOCATION_D] dry field, 62㎡, was purchased by agreement around 1995. [LOCATION_E] paddy field, 278㎡, was expropriated; three parcels, including [LOCATION_F], were sold around April 11, 1995; and [LOCATION_G] building site, 77㎡, was sold around February 28, 1998. Because the transaction dates of the nearby lands were after approval of the residential land development project plan, it appeared that the transaction prices included a substantial portion of the development gains from that development project.
neutral_fact_ko: [PERSON_A] 외 4인은 토지 소유자들로서 [COMPANY_A] 외 2인을 상대로 보상 평가와 관련된 분쟁을 제기하였다. neutral_fact_en: [PERSON_F] and [PERSON_A] were coworkers who often played pranks on each other. After a gathering, [PERSON_F] drove [VEHICLE_A], which belonged to another coworker, to take coworkers home. At about 07:57 on December 29, 2013, after [PERSON_F] had first let [PERSON_A] out and was preparing to leave, [PERSON_A] blocked [VEHICLE_A], said words to the effect of wanting another drink, and climbed onto its bonnet. [PERSON_F] slowly moved [VEHICLE_A] in an effort to get [PERSON_A] off the vehicle and then braked suddenly while [PERSON_A] was still hanging onto it. [PERSON_A] rolled off the bonnet, struck their head on the road, and sustained injuries including a traumatic subdural hemorrhage. [PERSON_F] later stated that the vehicle had been moved as a prank and that [PERSON_F] initially thought [PERSON_A] was continuing the prank. [PERSON_A] was left with permanent disabilities including partial paralysis of the lower limbs and impaired cognitive function and became severely dependent on daily adult assistance.
neutral_fact_ko: [PERSON_F]와 [PERSON_A]는 직장 동료였고 평소 서로 장난을 자주 치는 사이였다. neutral_fact_en: [COMPANY_A] entered into a comprehensive automobile insurance contract with [PERSON_B] that covered [PERSON_B]'s liability for damages to third parties arising from automobile accidents occurring while operating [VEHICLE_A]. During the insurance period, on March 12, 1992, [PERSON_B] caused an automobile accident while driving [VEHICLE_A], injuring [PERSON_A], who was approximately 35 years and 1 month old at the time, with severe brain contusion and other injuries. [PERSON_A] sustained severe brain contusion and other injuries in the automobile accident caused by [PERSON_B]. According to the medical examination, due to sequelae of severe brain damage, [PERSON_A] remained in a vegetative state and quadriplegic until the time of the examination, approximately 1 year and 2 months after the accident, received tube feeding after a tracheotomy, and was assessed as having no expectation of future improvement in symptoms. The medical examination estimated that [PERSON_A]'s life expectancy would be approximately 5 years from the date of the examination and approximately 6 years and 2 months from the date of the accident, and assessed that treatment to prevent complications and 8 hours of care per day would be necessary during the life-expectancy period. An agreement was reached on the basis of the prior assessment of [PERSON_A], and [PERSON_A] continued to survive beyond the assessed survival period, resulting in additional treatment costs, assistive-device costs, and care costs. At the examination on July 13, 1999, [PERSON_A]'s symptoms had improved from a vegetative state to a state of severe disability in which movement was impossible, and [PERSON_A]'s ability to survive had improved. The new examination expected [PERSON_A]'s life expectancy to be approximately 7.15 years from the date of the examination, approximately 8 years and 3 months longer than the survival period predicted in the prior examination. It was assessed that [PERSON_A] would continue to require treatment to prevent pneumonia and urinary tract infections and the care of one adult male for as long as [PERSON_A] survived. Due to the improvement in [PERSON_A]'s symptoms and the extension of the survival period, treatment, assistive devices, and care became additionally necessary after the period previously anticipated, resulting in additional costs and damages.
neutral_fact_ko: [COMPANY_A]는 [PERSON_B]와 [VEHICLE_A] 운행 중 발생한 자동차사고로 [PERSON_B]가 제3자에게 부담하게 되는 손해배상책임을 보장하는 자동차종합보험계약을 체결했다. [PERSON_B]는 보험기간 중인 1992년 3월 12일 [VEHICLE_A]를 운전하다가 당시 약 35세 1개월이었던 [PERSON_A]에게 중증 뇌좌상 등을 입힌 자동차사고를 일으켰다. [PERSON_A]는 [PERSON_B]가 일으킨 자동차사고로 중증 뇌좌상 등을 입었다. 신체감정 결과, [PERSON_A]는 중증 뇌손상 후유증으로 사고 후 약 1년 2개월이 지난 감정시점까지 식물인간 및 사지마비 상태가 지속되었고, 기관절개술 후 도관급식을 받았으며, 향후 증상의 호전을 기대할 수 없다는 평가를 받았다. 신체감정에서는 [PERSON_A]의 여명이 감정일부터 약 5년, 사고일부터 약 6년 2개월 정도일 것으로 추정되었고, 여명기간 동안 합병증 예방을 위한 치료와 하루 8시간의 개호가 필요하다고 평가되었다. [PERSON_A]에 대한 이전의 평가를 전제로 한 합의가 이루어졌고, [PERSON_A]는 그 평가된 생존기간이 지난 뒤에도 계속 생존하여 추가 치료비, 보조구비 및 개호비가 발생했다. 1999년 7월 13일 감정 당시 [PERSON_A]는 식물인간 상태에서 벗어나 거동이 불가능한 중증장애 상태로 증상이 호전되었고, 생존능력이 향상되었다. 새로운 감정에서는 [PERSON_A]의 여명이 감정일을 기준으로 약 7.15년, 이전 감정에서 예측된 생존기간보다 약 8년 3개월 더 길 것으로 예상되었다. [PERSON_A]는 생존하는 동안 폐렴과 요로감염 예방을 위한 치료 및 성인 남성 1명의 개호가 계속 필요하다는 평가를 받았다. [PERSON_A]의 증상 호전과 생존기간 연장으로 이전에 예상된 기간 이후의 치료, 보조구 및 개호가 추가로 필요하게 되었고, 이에 따라 추가적인 비용과 손해가 발생했다.

neutral_fact_en: At around 21:00 on September 2, 2004, [PERSON_A] drank alcohol with university club members at a bar called [COMPANY_A], operated by [PERSON_B], on the second floor of a three-story building. When [PERSON_A] became intoxicated and behaved noisily, the people accompanying [PERSON_A] took [PERSON_A] down to the first floor through a door leading to an external staircase. At around 22:50 on the same day, [PERSON_A] entered the bar again through [PROPERTY_B] and picked a quarrel with [PERSON_B], and the two engaged in a mutually violent altercation, including [PERSON_B] hitting [PERSON_A] on the cheek twice. [PERSON_C], the wife of [PERSON_B], held [PERSON_A]'s hand and took [PERSON_A] outside the bar through a door leading to an external staircase. At [PROPERTY_A], [PERSON_A] fell onto the ground-floor floor, and [PERSON_A] died on the 7th of the same month from, among other things, a subarachnoid hemorrhage injury. [PROPERTY_A] was jointly owned by [PERSON_D] and [PERSON_E], and at the time [PERSON_B] was operating a business after leasing [COMPANY_A] on the second floor. The height of [PROPERTY_C] was 0.76 m at the top step, 0.86 m at the first step from the top, and 0.92 m at the second step; the square railing support at the top of the stairs was 0.99 m, and the distance from the passage floor at the top of the stairs to the railing handrail was 0.94 m. neutral_fact_en: On April 1, 1996, [COMPANY_A] lent [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] to its affiliate [COMPANY_B] as a credit loan and, separately on the same day, lent [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] secured by 320,000 unlisted shares of its affiliate [COMPANY_C]. On April 29, 1996, [COMPANY_B] additionally borrowed [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] from [COMPANY_A] as a credit loan, and the total loan amount was [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B]. [INSTITUTION_A] pointed out to [COMPANY_A] that the collateral value for the stock-collateralized loan was insufficient and that additional collateral was needed. [COMPANY_A] requested additional collateral from [COMPANY_B], but [COMPANY_B] did not provide additional collateral. Subsequently, the personnel in charge at [COMPANY_A] decided to convert [COMPANY_B]'s collateral-backed loan into a credit loan and requested related materials, but around March 31, 1997, [COMPANY_B] sent only an official letter requesting the conversion without submitting financial statements, audit reports, or other materials. [PERSON_E] conducted a corporate evaluation using only publicly available materials, without [COMPANY_B]'s financial statements and audit reports, and when the result was below the threshold score for a credit loan, reassessed it by assigning high scores to some items so that it became 52.32 points. Although [PERSON_A] knew of the indication that additional collateral should be obtained, [PERSON_A] signed the loan approval document and the committee resolution without separate verification, and [PERSON_B] also signed the committee resolution without separate verification. As a result, the stock-collateralized loan to [COMPANY_B] was converted into a credit loan. According to [COMPANY_B]'s audit report, at the time of the conversion to a credit loan, [COMPANY_B] had incurred losses in 1995 and 1996, and its comprehensive corporate evaluation score was at most 47.63 points. On January 20, 1998, [COMPANY_A] received repayment of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] from [COMPANY_B] out of the existing loan amount, but around November 5, 1998, [COMPANY_B] defaulted. After the stock-collateralized loan among [COMPANY_B]'s loans was converted into a credit loan, [COMPANY_B] defaulted, and the remaining loan amount, including the converted [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A], was being repaid at an annual interest rate of 8.5% applicable to claims of financial institutions without collateral. Around December 1997, [COMPANY_A] established mortgages on 17 properties owned by [COMPANY_B] as collateral for the existing debt. When [COMPANY_B]'s tenant demanded the cancellation of the mortgages on the condition that the lease agreement be extended, an officer of [COMPANY_B] canceled the mortgages around July 22, 1998, using cancellation documents that had been kept in storage. To attract and maintain employee retirement reserve insurance contracts with [COMPANY_E] and [COMPANY_F], [PERSON_A] purchased and then sold beneficiary certificates issued by financial institutions. When [COMPANY_A] sold the beneficiary certificates purchased on September 4, 1996, on December 15, 1997, it incurred a loss of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A], and it incurred losses of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] and [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_C], respectively, from selling beneficiary certificates on February 2 and February 5, 1998. When [COMPANY_F] demanded that [COMPANY_A] cancel the insurance contract or provide a loan equal to twice the reserve, [COMPANY_A] sold the beneficiary certificates at a loss to resolve the liquidity shortage and respond to the refund request resulting from cancellation of the insurance contract.

neutral_fact_en: [PERSON_A] was a party to a dispute involving [PERSON_B], [PERSON_C], and [ORGANIZATION_A]. [PERSON_A]'s contract stated “2002 year month day,” rather than the actual drafting date of April 28, 2006; [PERSON_A] paid the member contribution directly to [COMPANY_A] and paid the entire amount in a lump sum before the unit-number drawing. [PERSON_C] received [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] out of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] from [COMPANY_A] as an intermediation fee and prepared and delivered a written undertaking of responsibility stating that, if a contractual problem arose for [PERSON_A], [PERSON_C] would repay [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]. Before and after entering into the contract with [PERSON_A], [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] continued to intermediate [COMPANY_A]'s contracts for recruiting additional members, and even on May 9, 2006, after the contract was entered into, they intermediated another person's contract for recruiting an additional member. If [COMPANY_A] entered into contracts after entering into the contract with [PERSON_A] while greatly exceeding the additional recruitment limit of 19 units, there was a high risk that it would become unable to perform the contract with [PERSON_A]. Of the eight people whose contracts [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] intermediated, four, including [PERSON_A], did not receive an apartment allocation and did not receive a refund of the principal they had paid to [COMPANY_A].

[PERSON_A]의 계약서에는 실제 작성일인 2006년 4월 28일이 아닌 ‘2002년 월 일’이 기재되었고, [PERSON_A]는 조합원분담금을 [COMPANY_A]에 직접 지급했으며 동·호수 추첨 전에 대금을 일시에 완납하였다. [PERSON_C]는 [COMPANY_A]로부터 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] 중 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B]를 중개수수료로 지급받았고, [PERSON_A]에게 계약상 문제가 발생하면 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]를 자신이 상환하겠다는 책임각서를 작성해 교부하였다. [PERSON_B]와 [PERSON_C]는 [PERSON_A]와의 계약 체결 전후에도 [COMPANY_A]의 조합원 충원 계약을 계속 중개했으며, 계약 체결 후인 2006년 5월 9일에도 다른 사람의 조합원 충원 계약을 중개하였다. [COMPANY_A]가 [PERSON_A]와의 계약 체결 후에도 추가 모집 한도인 19세대를 훨씬 초과하여 계약을 체결하면 [PERSON_A]와의 계약을 이행할 수 없게 될 위험성이 높았다. [PERSON_B]와 [PERSON_C]가 중개한 8명 중 [PERSON_A]를 포함한 4명은 아파트를 분양받지 못했고 [COMPANY_A]에 지급한 원금도 반환받지 못했다.

Through the brokerage of [PERSON_B], [PERSON_A] entered into a sale agreement for [PROPERTY_A] with [PERSON_C] on May 16, 2020, and agreed that [PERSON_C] would assume the lease deposit obligation owed to [ORGANIZATION_A] and that the amount would be deducted from the sale price. On May 18, 2020, [PERSON_A] received from [PERSON_C] payment of the remaining balance after deducting the lease deposit, and at the same time completed the registration of transfer of ownership of [PROPERTY_A] to [PERSON_C]. Without taking steps to assume the lease deposit obligation owed to [ORGANIZATION_A], [PERSON_C] created a mortgage over [PROPERTY_A] in favor of [PERSON_D] on May 25, 2020, and created a mortgage over it in favor of [COMPANY_A] on May 29, 2020. On August 3, 2020, [ORGANIZATION_A] claimed insurance benefits from [COMPANY_B], the insurer of [PRODUCT_A], on the ground that it had not received the lease deposit. After [PERSON_C] did not assume the lease deposit obligation owed to [ORGANIZATION_A], [ORGANIZATION_A] did not receive the lease deposit and claimed insurance benefits from [COMPANY_B]. After paying insurance benefits to [ORGANIZATION_A], [COMPANY_B] filed a lawsuit against [PERSON_A] seeking repayment of money. On May 26, 2019, [ORGANIZATION_B] entered into a mutual aid agreement that covered [PERSON_B]'s liability for damages, and the mutual aid amount was [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]. No circumstances were identified that would support considering that, during the brokerage process, [PERSON_B] provided [PERSON_A] with incorrect information, including that [PERSON_A] had been released from the obligation through [PERSON_C]'s assumption of the obligation.

neutral_fact_en: [PERSON_A] and two others, along with [ORGANIZATION_A], were parties to this matter. The road connecting [LOCATION_A] was a 9.6 m-wide, two-way, two-lane asphalt-paved road with a centerline, and at the end of a straight section in a mountainous inland area, it continued into a curve bending to the right. There was a retaining wall and a railway on the left side of the road, and a guardrail and a river on the right. The accident site was shaded, and snow covered the area up to near the centerline, making the centerline difficult to see; approximately 100 m of the lane in which the passenger car was traveling was icy and slippery. The accident date was January 18, which was in winter, and the weather at the time of the accident was clear. It appears that snow fell in the area before the accident, but the exact time and amount of the snowfall were not confirmed. [ORGANIZATION_A] did not install warnings or danger signs indicating an icy road at the accident site and did not carry out ice-removal work. The dump truck driver who witnessed the incident stated to the police that the road surface before the accident site was in normal condition and that it was a place where many accidents occurred because drivers unfamiliar with the area became flustered and braked suddenly at the icy right-curving section that appeared suddenly. [ORGANIZATION_A] claimed that the daily traffic volume at the accident site was at least 4,000 vehicles, but that no other traffic accidents occurred before or after the accident and that many vehicles passed through without difficulty. The records do not confirm whether any traffic accident other than this matter occurred at the accident site. After [PERSON_D] overtook [VEHICLE_A] approximately 300 m before the accident site, [PERSON_D] proceeded toward the accident site and braked to reduce speed. After [PERSON_D]'s passenger car struck the cement retaining wall, it slid and collided with [VEHICLE_B], which was traveling in the opposite lane. At the moment [PERSON_D] braked, the rear of the passenger car rotated toward the front and entered the opposite lane; as a result, it struck the cement retaining wall, then slid and collided with [VEHICLE_B].
neutral_fact_ko: [PERSON_A] 외 2인과 [ORGANIZATION_A]이 이 사건의 당사자였다. [LOCATION_A]을 잇는 도로는 폭 9.6m의 왕복 2차로 중앙선 설치 아스팔트 포장도로였고, 산간 내륙 지대의 직선 구간 끝에서 우측으로 굽는 곡선 구간으로 이어졌다. 도로 좌측에는 방호벽과 철로가, 우측에는 가드레일과 하천이 있었다. 사고 지점은 응달진 곳이었고 중앙선 부근까지 눈으로 덮여 중앙선이 잘 보이지 않았으며, 승용차가 진행한 차로 쪽 약 100m가 결빙되어 미끄러운 상태였다. 사고일은 겨울철인 1월 18일이었고, 사고 당시 날씨는 맑았다. 사고 전 해당 지역에 눈이 내린 것으로 보이지만 눈이 내린 정확한 시기와 양은 확인되지 않았다. [ORGANIZATION_A]은 사고 지점에 빙판길을 알리는 경고나 위험표지판을 설치하지 않았고, 빙판 제거 작업도 실시하지 않았다. 목격한 덤프트럭 운전자는 경찰에서 사고 지점 전의 노면은 정상 상태였고, 지리에 익숙하지 않은 운전자들이 갑자기 나타난 결빙된 우측 굴곡 구간에서 당황하여 급제동하다가 사고가 많이 발생하는 곳이라고 진술했다. [ORGANIZATION_A]은 사고 지점의 하루 교통량이 4,000대 이상이었지만 사고 전후에 다른 교통사고가 발생하지 않았고, 많은 차량이 어려움 없이 통행했다고 주장했다. 사고 지점에서 이 사건 외의 교통사고가 발생했는지는 기록상 확인되지 않았다. [PERSON_D]가 사고 지점 약 300m 전에서 [VEHICLE_A]를 추월한 후 사고 지점을 진행하다가 속도를 줄이려고 제동했다. [PERSON_D]의 승용차가 시멘트 방호벽을 충격한 후 미끄러지면서 반대 차로에서 진행하던 [VEHICLE_B]와 충돌했다. [PERSON_D]가 제동하는 순간 승용차의 후미가 앞쪽으로 돌면서 반대 차로로 들어갔고, 그 결과 시멘트 방호벽을 충격한 뒤 미끄러져 [VEHICLE_B]와 충돌했다.

neutral_fact_en: [PERSON_B_GROUP] was filed against [ORGANIZATION_A], and [PERSON_A] was admitted through the emergency room of [INSTITUTION_A] on January 14, 1998, due to severe dizziness and other symptoms. Based on the results of the medical history and visual examination of [PERSON_A], [PERSON_C] diagnosed cerebral infarction and administered an antiplatelet agent; the following day, an MRI showed multiple lacunar cerebral infarctions in the right cerebellum of [PERSON_A]. Based on [PERSON_A]'s symptoms and examination results, [PERSON_C] consulted with the supervising professor on January 17 and decided to conduct cerebral angiography to determine whether there was a cerebrovascular abnormality. For [PERSON_A]'s cerebral angiography, [PERSON_D] inserted a catheter into the right inguinal femoral artery and injected contrast medium with a syringe. While imaging the right vertebral artery, [PERSON_A] suddenly complained of a headache, so [PERSON_D] stopped the examination. [PERSON_A] lost consciousness, and a follow-up brain CT scan performed the same day confirmed infarctions in the brainstem and cerebellum. [PERSON_A] died on February 5, 1998, without regaining consciousness. The cause of [PERSON_A]'s death was cerebral infarction caused by a thrombus or atherosclerotic material in the body blocking the basilar artery; however, it was not established whether the pressure generated when [PERSON_D] administered the contrast medium caused the thrombus or other material to break off. At the time of the procedure, [PERSON_D] used a method of administering contrast medium little by little with a syringe, stopping the administration when a blood vessel appeared on the screen and continuing to administer contrast medium until it appeared when it was not clearly visible. At the time of admission, [PERSON_A] had lifestyle habits of obesity and excessive smoking and drinking, and the results of the examination and detailed tests confirmed severe cerebral infarction. [ORGANIZATION_A] sometimes received financial support from the government, Seoul City, and others, and sometimes operated youth-related facilities, sports facilities, and others under entrusted arrangements. [ORGANIZATION_A] initially started as a men's organization corresponding to [ORGANIZATION_A], but when it revised its charter in 1967, it opened membership eligibility to women as well, and as of 2004, the number of female ordinary members exceeded the number of male ordinary members. A person who agreed with the purposes of [ORGANIZATION_A] could become a member through the membership admission procedure. According to the charter and membership regulations of [ORGANIZATION_A], general members with voting rights and other rights were selected from among baptized and confirmed members of Christian churches who had paid a certain membership fee, had participated in [ORGANIZATION_A]'s activities continuously for at least two years as members, and were of a certain age or older, following recommendation by the Membership Committee and deliberation and decision by the Board of Directors. However, the membership department of [ORGANIZATION_A] had entirely excluded female members from the list of general members on the ground that [ORGANIZATION_A] had started as a men's organization and had been maintained and operated as a men's organization, and female members were in practice unable to become general members. [ORGANIZATION_A]는 여성회원들의 요구를 받아들여 2003년 2월 22일 정기총회에서 헌장개정특별위원회와 개혁특별위원회를 구성하기로 하고, 의사결정 과정에 여성과 남성이 동등한 자격으로 참여하며 여성에게 선거권과 피선거권을 부여하고 성차별적 요인을 해소하기로 하는 결의문을 채택하였다. 여성특별위원회는 여성회원이 총회원이 될 수 있도록 실무적으로 추진하자는 의견을 제시했고, 헌장개정특별위원회는 개정안을 이사회에 제출하였다. [ORGANIZATION_A]의 이사회는 여성의 총회참여를 헌장개정 사안으로 보아 총회의 결의로 결정하기로 하였고, 여성의 총회참여를 인정하자는 의견이 투표자의 과반수이면 다음 해 헌장개정절차를 거쳐 정기총회에 반영하기로 하였다. 2005년 2월 26일 정기총회에서 헌장개정안은 원안대로 가결되었으나, 여성의 총회참여를 인정하자는 찬성표는 투표자의 과반수에 이르지 못하였다. [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 2003년, 2004년, 2006년에 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 총회원 권한을 요청하거나 총회원 자격 부여를 위한 절차 수행을 요청하는 서류를 보냈지만, 해당 시점까지 총회원으로 선정되지 못했다. [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 구성원으로서 회비를 부담했지만, 여성이라는 이유로 총회의결권 등을 행사할 기회를 지속적으로 갖지 못했다. [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 여성이라는 이유로 총회원 선정이 원천적으로 제한되자 2003년, 2004년, 2006년에 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 권한 부여나 자격 부여 절차를 요청하는 서류를 보냈다. [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 총회원으로 선정되지 못한 뒤 2007년 이후 회비 납부를 중단했다. 이러한 일련의 과정에서 [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 정신적 손해를 입었다. 2004년 3월경 영·호남지역 21개 YMCA는 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 여성회원들에게 총회원 자격을 부여하도록 권고하였다. [ORGANIZATION_B]은 2004년 5월 15일 여성회원들에게 총회원 자격을 즉시 부여하도록 권고하였고, 2006년 6월에는 자격을 부여하지 않을 경우 퇴회나 이에 준하는 제재조치를 실행하기로 결의하였다. [ORGANIZATION_C]는 2004년 5월 [ORGANIZATION_A]가 여성이라는 이유로 여성회원들의 총회의결권 등을 배제한 사실을 확인하고 [ORGANIZATION_A]에 시정을 권고하였다. 여야 국회의원 83명으로 구성된 국회양성포럼도 2005년 5월 [ORGANIZATION_A]의 차별적 처우에 대해 유감을 표명하고 신속한 시정을 권고하였다.

neutral_fact_en: On the evening of March 3, 2004, after drinking with friends, [PERSON_A] drove [VEHICLE_A] and was stopped by personnel from [ORGANIZATION_B] at about 22:30. A breath test at about 22:43 measured a blood-alcohol concentration of 0.055%. [PERSON_A] immediately requested a blood test, but no approved blood-collection container was available at the location, so another officer went to obtain one. During the wait, the officer accompanied [PERSON_A] to [INSTITUTION_A] and prepared identification records and a statement. Blood was collected at [INSTITUTION_B] at about 23:55, and the blood analysis showed a concentration of 0.078%. [PERSON_A] alleged that, although a blood test had been requested immediately after the breath test, the blood was not collected until 1 hour and 12 minutes later, increasing the measured concentration and causing pecuniary and mental harm.

[PERSON_A] conceived [ALLOY_B], made by mixing [ALLOY_C] and [ALLOY_D] at ratios of 6:4, 7:3, and 8:2, respectively, and requested [PERSON_B] to analyze and optimize the physical properties of [ALLOY_B]. Around August 2008, it became known that [ALLOY_B] had exceptionally high strength but was brittle, and the pursuit of a patent application and commercialization was abandoned. Around December 2008, after receiving a request from [COMPANY_B] to cast mobile-phone hinges using an alloy stronger than existing commercial alloys, [PERSON_A] pursued the development of a new alloy based on the past experience of developing [ALLOY_B]. While conducting experiments in his laboratory to develop a new [PRODUCT_B] alloy containing [ALLOY_A], [PERSON_B] specifically reported to [PERSON_A] the contents of each experiment and the schedule for the next experiment before and after each experiment. Together, around February 16, 2009, [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] cast exterior parts for mobile phones as prototypes of new [PRODUCT_B] alloys at [COMPANY_A]’s factory, and after [PERSON_B] completed the physical-property analysis of the cast products, development of [ALLOY_A] was completed. After developing [ALLOY_A], [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] did not proceed with the procedure of transferring [PERSON_A]’s share to [COMPANY_A], and sought to register the invention in its entirety solely in [PERSON_B]’s name and jointly obtain profits through [BUSINESS_A]; in fact, they entered into license agreements concerning [ALLOY_A] with [COMPANY_C] and [COMPANY_D]. It is recorded that [PERSON_A] transferred [PERSON_A]’s share to [PERSON_B] without informing [COMPANY_A] that [ALLOY_A] had been completed, thereby causing [PERSON_B] to register it alone, and that [COMPANY_A] suffered damage because [PERSON_B] was caused to enter into license agreements with other companies through the arrangement of [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_C]. [BUSINESS_A], operated by [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B], received [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] from [COMPANY_D] as technology royalties for the patent for the [ALLOY_A] invention.

neutral_fact_en: [PERSON_A] rented [PROPERTY_A] from [PERSON_B] from 2017. 5. 25. to 2019. 24., and [COMPANY_A] acquired ownership of all of [PROPERTY_B] on 2019. 1. 15. [PROPERTY_B] received approval for use around 1977. After receiving a certified-content notice from [PERSON_A] around 2019. 2. 13. requesting that [COMPANY_A] clearly state its intention to renew the lease agreement and its intention to enter into an agreement with a new tenant, [COMPANY_A] sent [PERSON_A] a certified-content notice on 2019. 3. 6. stating that it was planning and preparing to construct a new building within several years; that, if a renewal of the agreement was requested, it would increase the deposit and monthly rent by 5% each and specifically notify the plans for demolition and reconstruction at the time of the renewal agreement; and that it would also specifically notify the plans for demolition and reconstruction when entering into a new agreement with a new tenant. After clearly stating that [PERSON_A] had no intention to renew, [PERSON_A] vacated [PROPERTY_A] on 2019. 24., but did not actually arrange a new tenant for [COMPANY_A] or provide information about a person seeking to become a new tenant. After [COMPANY_A] leased [PROPERTY_A] to [PERSON_C] and others around 2019. 7. 4., it ultimately set the lease term for all of [PROPERTY_B] at 36 months. The special provisions of the new lease agreement and the settlement agreement included the plan to demolish and reconstruct all of [PROPERTY_B], the construction time around 2022. 3., and a required period of one year, and a floor plan was also attached. The lower court determined that [COMPANY_A]’s statement, “We will notify the new tenant of the planned reconstruction and reflect it when entering into the new lease agreement,” caused a person seeking to become a new tenant to hesitate to enter into the new lease agreement. According to the lower court, [COMPANY_A]’s statement that it would notify the person seeking to become a new tenant of the planned reconstruction and reflect it when entering into the new lease agreement was the cause of that person’s hesitation to enter into the agreement. The new lease agreement that [COMPANY_A] entered into with [PERSON_C] and others specifically stated the plan to demolish and reconstruct all of [PROPERTY_B], as well as the construction timing and required period.

neutral_fact_en: In the project for supplying boiler equipment ordered by [COMPANY_C], [COMPANY_B], which formed a consortium with [COMPANY_A], entrusted [COMPANY_D] with arranging sea transportation for [PRODUCT_A]. [COMPANY_E] entered into a charterparty agreement with [COMPANY_F], and [COMPANY_F] entered into a charterparty agreement with [COMPANY_G] on terms of Free In and Out, Stowed and Trimming (FIOST), under which the charterer bears the loading, discharging, stowage, and trimming costs. On January 11, 2013, after receiving [PRODUCT_A] from [COMPANY_A], [COMPANY_G] issued [DOCUMENT_A], identifying [COMPANY_A] as the shipper, [COMPANY_C] as the consignee, and [COMPANY_B] as the notify party. The terms on the reverse side of [DOCUMENT_A] included a provision that the carrier bears no responsibility for damage occurring before loading or after discharge, and a provision that the carrier’s performing assistants, agents, and subcontractors may invoke the defenses and limitations of liability that the carrier may assert. At [COMPANY_A]’s request, [COMPANY_G] took back [DOCUMENT_A], stamped “Surrender” on its face, and arranged for the goods to be delivered to the consignee without collecting the original. Under the terms of the principal charterparty agreement, [COMPANY_E] subcontracted the discharge operations at the discharge port to [COMPANY_H], and [COMPANY_I] was further subcontracted to perform those operations. While an employee of [COMPANY_I] was performing the discharge operations for [PRODUCT_A], [PRODUCT_A] fell and was damaged. [COMPANY_A] incurred repair costs and other expenses for [PRODUCT_A]. Because [PRODUCT_A] fell and was damaged during the discharge operations and [COMPANY_A] then incurred repair costs and other expenses, the fall and damage that occurred during the discharge operations led to the expenditure of repair costs and other expenses.

neutral_fact_en: [COMPANY_A] entered into a contract for construction of power-generation facilities with [COMPANY_B], [COMPANY_C], and [COMPANY_D] on December 22, 2003. [COMPANY_B] entered into a supply contract for [PRODUCT_A] with [COMPANY_E], and [COMPANY_E] received [PRODUCT_A] from a Japanese company and supplied it to [COMPANY_B], after which [COMPANY_B], [COMPANY_C], and [COMPANY_D] installed [PRODUCT_A] at [COMPANY_A]'s power-generation facility and completed the power-generation facility construction. [COMPANY_A] began test operation of [PRODUCT_A] on August 3, 2006, and began commercial operation of [PRODUCT_A] on December 2, 2006. During an insulation test, one insulation bolt of [PRODUCT_A] was found to be broken, and an ultrasonic inspection found that four additional insulation bolts were damaged. Accordingly, [PRODUCT_A] was repaired, including by replacing all 18 insulation bolts, including the five damaged insulation bolts. [COMPANY_A] was unable to operate the power plant normally during the approximately 40-day repair period. When [PRODUCT_A] was not operating, all power-generation equipment functionally connected to [PRODUCT_A] could not be operated, and power production was therefore halted. This accident occurred due to a defect in the manufacture or installation of [PRODUCT_A]. Due to this accident, [COMPANY_A] was unable to produce electricity for 40 days, from August 1, 2007, to September 9, 2007, and consequently suffered damage of [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A].

[PRODUCT_A]를 태우면 연기 중에 타르, 니코틴, 일산화탄소 등을 비롯한 유해성분이 발생하고, 니코틴은 흡연 시 체내에 흡수된다. 원고들은 피고들이 유해한 첨가제를 사용하여 담배 연기의 pH와 니코틴 흡수율 또는 니코틴 함량을 조작했다고 주장하였다. 원고들은 [COUNTRY_A]가 흡연을 강요하거나 권장했고, 국산담배 소비를 장려하여 흡연자들의 흡연을 유발하거나 촉진했다고 주장하였다. 언론 보도와 규제를 통해 흡연이 폐암 등 호흡기 질환의 원인이 될 수 있다는 인식이 사회 전반에 퍼졌고, 흡연을 시작하거나 계속할지 및 금연이 어려울 수 있다는 점도 널리 인식되어 있었다.

There were plaintiffs who were children of [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B], and [COMPANY_A] was the importing company of [VEHICLE_A]. At around 10:50 a.m. on May 4, 2018, [PERSON_A] was driving [VEHICLE_A] on [LOCATION_C] from the Hoedeok direction toward the Nonsan direction, and proceeded along the shoulder near [LOCATION_A]. Subsequently, [PERSON_A] proceeded straight at [LOCATION_B], collided with the guardrail ahead, and fell. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] died in this accident. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] died in the accident in which [VEHICLE_A] collided with the guardrail ahead and fell. Around the time of the accident, [VEHICLE_A] traveled at high speed along the shoulder for approximately 300 m at a speed of 321.9 km/h or more, and its emergency warning lights were operating. The accident occurred at around 10:50 a.m. in clear weather. Before reaching the accident location, [PERSON_A] drove [VEHICLE_A] at speeds ranging from 128.7 km/h to 160.9 km/h, and her husband, [PERSON_B], was seated in the passenger seat. At the time, [PERSON_A] was 66 years old, had no significant health problems, and had no record of being charged administrative fines for speeding or other reasons. The plaintiffs claimed that the accident occurred because [VEHICLE_A] suddenly accelerated, contrary to [PERSON_A]'s operation. There was no direct evidence concerning the driver's pedal operation, and the plaintiffs had to prove as an indirect fact that [PERSON_A] had not operated the pedals incorrectly. The abnormal driving of [VEHICLE_A], its normal driving immediately before the accident, and [PERSON_A]'s driving experience presented by the plaintiffs did not exclude the possibility of incorrect pedal operation. [VEHICLE_A] was completely burned in the accident. The dashcam recordings of vehicles nearby at the time of the accident recorded [VEHICLE_A] from approximately 10 seconds before the accident until the time of the accident, and video analysis showed that [VEHICLE_A]'s brake lights were not illuminated. The brake lights of most vehicles operate through a switch connected to the brake pedal, so, absent special circumstances, the brake lights illuminate when the brake pedal is pressed. The fact that the brake lights were not illuminated at the time of this accident suggested the possibility that [PERSON_A] had not pressed the brake pedal.

neutral_fact_en: [COMPANY_A] was the plaintiff, and [COMPANY_B] was the defendant. Around 1998, [COMPANY_C] entered into a purchase-of-goods contract concerning [PRODUCT_A] with [COMPANY_B], received delivery of [PRODUCT_A] from [COMPANY_B] on October 31, 2000, and began operation around March 29, 2001. Around 10:34 a.m. on April 1, 2011, [PRODUCT_C] among the 19-stage blades constituting the compressor of [PRODUCT_B] within [PRODUCT_A] fractured. The fracture damaged all of the compressor blades, and consequently damaged the turbine blades and the upper bearing pads, among other components. The fracture of [PRODUCT_C] led to damage to all of the compressor blades, and that damage led to damage to the turbine blades and the upper bearing pads, among other components. [COMPANY_C] suffered damage from this accident, and the amount of that damage was assessed at [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]. On January 31, 2011, [COMPANY_A] entered into a comprehensive property insurance contract concerning [PRODUCT_A] with [COMPANY_C] and paid [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B] as insurance benefits for part of the accident damage. [COMPANY_A] claimed that [PRODUCT_C] had fine cracks from the time of manufacture. [ORGANIZATION_A] prepared the final accident-cause investigation report, and that report and witness testimony were presented as evidence supporting [COMPANY_A]’s claim concerning fine cracks. It is recorded that the investigation proceeded without [COMPANY_B]’s participation and that fragments of the fractured blade were lost. [COMPANY_A] claimed that an incomplete [PRODUCT_C] with a manufacturing defect, caused by fine cracks arising during the manufacturing process or the use of a material vulnerable to corrosion, caused the [PRODUCT_B] accident. [COMPANY_A] claimed that the [PRODUCT_B] accident occurred at 26,332 operating hours, within the maintenance interval of the notified 48,000 equivalent-base-load operating hours.
neutral_fact_ko: [COMPANY_C]는 1998년경 [COMPANY_B]와 [PRODUCT_A]에 관한 물품구매계약을 체결했고, 2000년 10월 31일 [COMPANY_B]로부터 [PRODUCT_A]를 인도받아 2001년 3월 29일경 운전을 개시했다. 2011년 4월 1일 10시 34분경 [PRODUCT_A] 중 [PRODUCT_B]의 압축기를 구성하는 19단 블레이드 가운데 [PRODUCT_C]가 파단되었다. 파단으로 인해 압축기의 전체 블레이드가 손상되었고, 이에 따라 터빈 블레이드와 상부 베어링 패드 등이 손상되었다. [PRODUCT_C]의 파단이 압축기의 전체 블레이드 손상으로 이어졌고, 그 손상이 터빈 블레이드와 상부 베어링 패드 등의 손상으로 이어졌다. [COMPANY_C]에게 이 사고로 손해가 발생했고, 그 손해액은 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]로 사정되었다. [COMPANY_A]는 2011년 1월 31일 [COMPANY_C]와 [PRODUCT_A]에 관한 재산종합보험계약을 체결했고, 사고 손해 중 일부로 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B]를 보험금으로 지급했다. [COMPANY_A]는 [PRODUCT_C]에 제조 시부터 미세한 균열이 있었다고 주장했다. [ORGANIZATION_A]가 사고원인조사 최종보고서를 작성했고, 해당 보고서와 증인 진술이 [COMPANY_A]의 미세한 균열 주장에 부합하는 증거로 제시되었다. [COMPANY_B]의 참여 없이 조사가 진행되었고, 파단된 블레이드 파편이 분실되었다는 사정이 기록되어 있다. [COMPANY_A]는 제조과정에서 발생한 미세한 균열 또는 부식에 취약한 재료의 사용으로 제조상 결함이 있는 불완전한 [PRODUCT_C]가 [PRODUCT_B] 사고를 발생시켰다고 주장했다. [PRODUCT_B] 사고는 고지된 48,000 등가기저부하운전시간의 정비주기 내인 26,332 운전시간 시점에 발생했다고 [COMPANY_A]가 주장했다.

neutral_fact_en: [COMPANY_A] was the insurer that entered into an insurance contract compensating losses caused by fire and other events involving a house owned by [PERSON_A], and [COMPANY_B] was the company that manufactured [PRODUCT_A]. On October 13, 1994, [COMPANY_A] entered into a long-term comprehensive insurance contract covering losses caused by fire, theft, explosion, and other events involving the two-story house owned by [PERSON_A] located in [LOCATION_A], and the insurance period was from October 13, 1994, to October 13, 2004. Around noon on July 3, 1996, while [PERSON_B] was watching the 40.64 cm Video Vision television manufactured by [COMPANY_B] in the main bedroom on the second floor of [PROPERTY_A], black smoke rose from behind the television, so [PERSON_B] turned off the operating switch and unplugged the power cord. Immediately afterward, flames rose from [PRODUCT_A] with an explosive sound and spread to the curtains. The fire completely destroyed the interior of the second floor of [PROPERTY_A] and the household goods in it. The incident is presumed to have occurred when the electronic-gun portion inside the picture tube of [PRODUCT_A] exploded due to an electrical leakage, and the circumstances in which the electrical leakage occurred were not determined. [PRODUCT_A] was manufactured between the end of 1988 and the beginning of 1990, and [PERSON_A] purchased it about 6 years before the fire and used it until the incident, without repairing it or changing its internal structure during that period. [COMPANY_A] paid [PERSON_A] [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] and [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B], totaling [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_C], as insurance proceeds for the building damage caused by the incident. [COMPANY_B] claimed that the incident occurred due to misuse or negligent maintenance by [PERSON_A]. The service life of [PRODUCT_A] set by [COMPANY_B] was 5 years from the date of purchase, and the incident occurred about 1 year after that service life had passed.

[PRODUCT_A]의 수상관 내부 전자총 부분이 누전으로 폭발하면서 사고가 발생한 것으로 추정되며, 누전이 발생한 경위는 밝혀지지 않았다. [PRODUCT_A]는 1988년 말부터 1990년 초 사이에 제조되었고, [PERSON_A]는 화재 발생 약 6년 전에 이를 구입하여 사고 때까지 사용했으며, 그동안 수리하거나 내부 구조를 변경하지 않았다. [COMPANY_A]는 [PERSON_A]에게 사고로 인한 건물 피해 보험금으로 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A]와 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_B], 합계 [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_C]를 지급했다. [COMPANY_B]는 사고가 [PERSON_A]의 오사용 또는 관리소홀로 발생했다고 주장했다. neutral_fact_en: [COMPANY_A] entered into an automobile comprehensive insurance contract with [PERSON_A] on April 18, 1992, covering direct damage to [VEHICLE_A] caused by fire and similar events. [PERSON_A]'s son, [PERSON_B], parked [VEHICLE_A] at [LOCATION_A] at about 21:40 on April 8, 1993, and the vehicle was completely burned in a fire that arose near the driver's side at about 23:50 that day. [COMPANY_A] paid [PERSON_A] [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] on June 1, 1993. [PERSON_A] had purchased [VEHICLE_A] in November 1992. Soon after purchase, the vehicle was inspected several times because of abnormal engine signs, and in March 1993 the alternator and surrounding parts were replaced. No other fire occurred nearby, and the vehicle's horn continued to sound during the fire. Two unfamiliar people had been in the underground parking lot about 30 minutes before the fire, but no trace was found showing that they had caused it. During the police investigation, [PERSON_C] stated that after hearing the horn and entering the parking lot, [PERSON_C] saw dense smoke inside the vehicle and a small flame near the front of the driver's seat. The vehicle was burned beyond repair, and the specific component or location where the fire began was not identified. No expert examination was conducted, and the cause of the fire remained undetermined. After purchasing the vehicle, [PERSON_A] had interior work performed that could involve adding or modifying electrical wiring.

neutral_fact_en: [PERSON_A] were veterans who had been deployed to and served in [LOCATION_A], or their bereaved family members, and they claimed that, after being exposed to [PRODUCT_A] sprayed in [LOCATION_A], they returned home and developed diseases. Around early 1965, [COMPANY_A] developed an analytical method capable of detecting [CHEMICAL_A] concentrations down to 1 ppm or less, established manufacturing specifications reducing the concentration of [CHEMICAL_A] to approximately 1 ppm, and knew a method of reducing the risk of [CHEMICAL_A] contamination through a wastewater-treatment process. [COMPANY_B] did not establish manufacturing standards concerning the concentration of [CHEMICAL_A], but knew that the risk of contamination could be reduced by adding information about the harmfulness of [CHEMICAL_A], the existence of that analytical method, and the wastewater-treatment process. [COMPANY_C] adopted a different manufacturing process and produced [PRODUCT_A] containing [CHEMICAL_A] at 0.1 ppm or less. The relevant [PERSON_A] who served in [LOCATION_A] developed [DISEASE_A] after their service ended. It was recognized as probable that [PERSON_A] developed [DISEASE_A] after being exposed during their service to [CHEMICAL_A] contained in [PRODUCT_A], and it was determined that they suffered harm from developing [DISEASE_A] after being exposed to [CHEMICAL_A] in [PRODUCT_A] sprayed or remaining in their service areas and elsewhere. [DISEASE_B], including the diabetes suffered by [PERSON_A], was not a disease that arose only from exposure to [CHEMICAL_A] contained in [PRODUCT_A], but was a disease that could arise from various congenital and acquired factors. neutral_fact_en: [PERSON_A] and [COMPANY_A] were identified as the parties in this matter. The pilots of [PRODUCT_A] flew at an altitude of 1828.8m, where visibility was poor and the temperature fell to as low as -8℃. The pilots of [PRODUCT_A] did not activate the pitot heat intended to prevent the pitot tubes from icing. Because the pitot heat was not activated, the pitot tubes froze, and as a result the speed indicated on the airspeed indicator decreased differently from the actual speed, while the trailing edge of the stabilizer moved downward and the helicopter’s attitude tilted forward. Without properly understanding the situation, the pilots increased power in an attempt to increase speed after observing that [PRODUCT_A]’s speed on the airspeed indicator was decreasing. As a result of the pilots increasing power after observing that [PRODUCT_A]’s speed on the airspeed indicator was decreasing, [PRODUCT_A] entered a steep dive. While the pilots belatedly attempted to recover [PRODUCT_A]’s attitude, one of [PRODUCT_A]’s main rotor blades struck the rear fuselage. After the main rotor blade struck the rear fuselage, [PRODUCT_A] crashed. The flight manual warned of the possibility of abnormal stabilizer operation and explained how to respond to it. Given the characteristics of [PRODUCT_A] in this matter, it was something the pilots could readily know that abnormal stabilizer operation could be caused by icing of the pitot tubes. neutral_fact_en: [PERSON_GROUP_A] owned land and a factory in [LOCATION_A], and [PERSON_B] carried out a land-filling project that raised the ground level of adjacent [PROPERTY_A]. After the land filling, the maximum amount of water that [LOCATION_A] could hold before [PERSON_GROUP_A]'s land and factory would flood was estimated to have decreased from 368,000 cubic meters to 67,000 cubic meters, and the cumulative rainfall threshold for flooding under ordinary soil conditions was estimated to have decreased from 352 millimeters to 172 millimeters. Before the project, [PERSON_GROUP_A]'s land and factory had not flooded when water levels reached 10.96 meters, 10.63 meters, 11.03 meters, and 10.8 meters. During [STORM_B] on September 13, 2003, however, the land and factory flooded when the highest water level was 7.64 meters and cumulative rainfall was about 179 millimeters. Flood damage occurred during [STORM_A] and [STORM_B]. The investigative materials described circumstances in which the raised ground level of [PROPERTY_A] restricted rainwater flowing away from [PERSON_GROUP_A]'s land and factory. After [STORM_B], [PERSON_A] reported to [INSTITUTION_A] that products such as washbasins and machinery such as kilns had been damaged by flooding. [PERSON_A] also alleged that flooding prevented operation of the factory from around September 2000 through around December 2006 and caused business losses.
neutral_fact_ko: [PERSON_GROUP_A]는 [LOCATION_A]에 토지와 공장을 보유하고 있었고, [PERSON_B]는 인접한 [PROPERTY_A]의 지반을 높이는 성토사업을 시행했다. 성토 뒤 [PERSON_GROUP_A]의 토지와 공장이 침수되기 전 [LOCATION_A]가 저장할 수 있는 최대 수량은 368,000세제곱미터에서 67,000세제곱미터로 감소했고, 통상적인 토양 상태에서 침수가 시작될 수 있는 누적 강우량도 352밀리미터에서 172밀리미터로 감소한 것으로 조사되었다. 성토 전에는 수위가 10.96미터, 10.63미터, 11.03미터, 10.8미터에 이른 때에도 [PERSON_GROUP_A]의 토지와 공장이 침수되지 않았지만, 2003년 9월 13일 [STORM_B] 때에는 최고 수위가 7.64미터이고 누적 강우량이 약 179밀리미터인 상태에서 토지와 공장이 침수되었다. [STORM_A]와 [STORM_B] 때 토지와 공장에 침수 피해가 발생했다. 조사자료에는 [PROPERTY_A]의 성토로 인해 [PERSON_GROUP_A]의 토지와 공장에서 흘러나가는 빗물의 흐름이 제한된 사정이 기재되어 있었다. [STORM_B] 뒤 [PERSON_A]는 [INSTITUTION_A]에 세면대 제품과 가마 등 기계가 침수로 손상되었다고 신고했다. [PERSON_A]는 침수로 2000년 9월경부터 2006년 12월경까지 공장을 가동하지 못해 영업손실도 발생했다고 주장했다.

neutral_fact_en: [COMPANY_B] owned [VESSEL_A] and chartered it to [COMPANY_C] for 24 months on September 12, 2000. [COMPANY_C] then chartered [VESSEL_A] to [PERSON_A] for the same period. On August 25, 2001, [PERSON_A] entered into a contract to transport frozen fish from fishing grounds to [LOCATION_B]. On September 9, 2001, [VESSEL_A] transshipped [SHIPMENT_A] from [VESSEL_B] and [SHIPMENT_B] from [VESSEL_C], remained in [LOCATION_A] while taking on frozen fish from other fishing vessels, departed on October 22, 2001, and arrived at [LOCATION_B] on October 31. The contracts required the cargo hold to be maintained at −18 °C. During unloading at about 14:00 on November 1, 2001, [SHIPMENT_A] and [SHIPMENT_B], both consisting of frozen Pacific saury, were found to be severely dried and discolored. [COMPANY_A], which had issued marine cargo insurance for the shipments, paid insurance benefits to [COMPANY_F] and [COMPANY_G] after the cargo damage. [PERSON_A] issued and delivered bills of lading for [SHIPMENT_A] and [SHIPMENT_B]. [COMPANY_A] alleged that the actual transport and handling of the cargo by [PERSON_A]'s side was related to the cargo damage.
neutral_fact_ko: [COMPANY_B]는 [VESSEL_A]의 소유자였고, 2000년 9월 12일 [VESSEL_A]를 24개월 동안 [COMPANY_C]에 용선했다. [COMPANY_C]는 같은 기간 동안 [VESSEL_A]를 [PERSON_A]에게 다시 용선했다. 2001년 8월 25일 [PERSON_A]는 어장에서 [LOCATION_B]까지 냉동수산물을 운송하는 계약을 체결했다. 2001년 9월 9일 [VESSEL_A]는 [VESSEL_B]와 [VESSEL_C]에서 각각 [SHIPMENT_A]와 [SHIPMENT_B]를 옮겨 실었고, 다른 어선의 냉동수산물도 옮겨 실은 뒤 2001년 10월 22일 [LOCATION_A]를 출발해 10월 31일 [LOCATION_B]에 도착했다. 계약에는 화물창을 영하 18도로 유지한다는 내용이 포함되어 있었다. 2001년 11월 1일 약 14시 하역 과정에서 냉동 꽁치로 구성된 [SHIPMENT_A]와 [SHIPMENT_B]가 심하게 건조되고 변색된 상태로 발견되었다. [COMPANY_A]는 두 화물에 관한 해상적하보험계약을 체결한 보험자로서 화물 손상 후 [COMPANY_F]와 [COMPANY_G]에 보험금을 지급했다. [PERSON_A]는 [SHIPMENT_A]와 [SHIPMENT_B]에 관하여 각각 선하증권을 발행·교부했다. neutral_fact_en: In December 1999, [PERSON_A] suffered a fatal accident while driving an off-highway dump truck within the scope of his employment with [COMPANY_A], the general contractor on a construction site owned by [ORGANIZATION_A]. His wife and administratrix of his estate, [PERSON_B], brought an action against [ORGANIZATION_A] and the construction manager of the project, [COMPANY_B]. [PERSON_A] was driving an off-highway dump truck within the scope of his employment with [COMPANY_A] at a construction site owned by [ORGANIZATION_A]. [COMPANY_A] was the general contractor, and [COMPANY_B] was the construction manager. On the afternoon of December 1, 1999, [COMPANY_A] asked [PERSON_A], who usually drove water trucks on the site, to drive a loaded, heavy-duty, off-highway dump truck up a hill on a haul road, even though he had never driven that type of truck on this worksite. Testimony indicated that [PERSON_A] was apprehensive about driving that type of truck but accepted the assignment. [COMPANY_A] constructed temporary unpaved haul roads to transport materials between sections of the project. Testimony indicated that [COMPANY_B] inspectors had authority to act regarding safety violations on haul roads and could stop work if they perceived a dangerous condition. [COMPANY_A] had no contractual relationship with [COMPANY_B], and its contract with [ORGANIZATION_A] assigned [COMPANY_A] responsibility for the safety of its employees on site. [COMPANY_B] contended that [PERSON_A] drove off the road to avoid an oncoming grader despite having sufficient room to pass. [PERSON_B] asserted that the haul road collapsed because instability in the hill caused by coal seams. [PERSON_B] alleged that the haul road should have had flaggers, barricades, or radio contact for truck drivers. She also alleged that [COMPANY_B] failed to require proper construction and maintenance of the haul road and failed to inspect it. [COMPANY_B]'s safety monitor was to represent [ORGANIZATION_A] in construction-safety matters, review and approve contractor emergency procedures and site-safety plans, interview applicants for contractors' safety representatives, monitor those representatives' performance, and monitor contractors' compliance with applicable safety regulations at all work operations on a frequent and regular schedule. [PERSON_A] suffered fatal injuries when the truck plunged down an 8.5-meter embankment and landed upside down in 1.2 meters of water. [COMPANY_B] asserted that [PERSON_A]'s death resulted from the construction and maintenance of the haul road by [COMPANY_A]. An expert stated that [COMPANY_B]'s representative traveled on haul roads but did not notice steep grades, narrow width, faulty slope configuration, inadequate drainage, or the absence of a safety berm, and did not address hazardous weather conditions on the day of the accident despite concerns expressed by employees.

[COMPANY_A]는 종합계약자였고, [COMPANY_B]는 건설 관리자였다. 1999년 12월 1일 오후, 현장에서 보통 물 운반 트럭을 운전하던 [PERSON_A]에게 [COMPANY_A]는 적재된 대형 비도로용 덤프트럭을 운반도로를 따라 언덕 위로 운전하라고 요청했다. [COMPANY_A]는 프로젝트의 구역들 사이에서 자재를 운반하기 위해 임시 비포장 운반도로를 건설했다. 증언에 따르면 [COMPANY_B]의 검사관들은 운반도로의 안전 위반에 관해 조치할 권한이 있었고, 위험한 상태라고 판단하면 작업을 중단시킬 수 있었다. [COMPANY_A]는 [COMPANY_B]와 계약 관계가 없었고, [ORGANIZATION_A]와의 계약에 따라 현장 직원들의 안전에 대한 책임을 [COMPANY_A]가 부담하도록 되어 있었다. [COMPANY_B]는 [PERSON_A]가 지나갈 충분한 공간이 있었음에도 마주 오던 그레이더를 피하기 위해 도로 밖으로 운전했다고 주장했다. [PERSON_B]는 탄층으로 인해 발생한 언덕의 불안정성 때문에 운반도로가 붕괴했다고 주장했다. [PERSON_B]는 운반도로에 신호수, 바리케이드 또는 트럭 운전자들을 위한 무선 연락이 있어야 했다고 주장했다. 또한 [COMPANY_B]가 운반도로의 적절한 건설과 유지관리를 요구하지 않았고 이를 검사하지도 않았다고 주장했다. [COMPANY_B]의 안전 담당자는 건설 안전 문제에서 [ORGANIZATION_A]를 대표하고, 계약자의 비상 절차와 현장 안전 계획을 검토하고 승인하며, 계약자의 안전 대표자 지원자들을 면접하고, 해당 대표자들의 업무 수행을 감독하며, 모든 작업에서 계약자들이 적용 가능한 안전 규정을 준수하는지를 빈번하고 정기적으로 감독하도록 되어 있었다. 트럭이 8.5미터 높이의 둑 아래로 곤두박질쳐 1.2미터 깊이의 물속에 거꾸로 떨어지면서 [PERSON_A]는 치명적인 부상을 입었다. [COMPANY_B]는 [PERSON_A]의 사망이 [COMPANY_A]의 운반도로 건설 및 유지관리상 과실이 있었다고 주장되는 행위에서 비롯되었다고 주장했다. 한 전문가는 [COMPANY_B]의 대표자가 운반도로를 이동했지만 급한 경사, 좁은 폭, 잘못된 경사면 형상, 불충분한 배수 또는 안전 둑의 부재를 알아차리지 못했고, 직원들이 우려를 표명했음에도 사고 당일의 위험한 기상 상태에 대처하지 않았다고 진술했다.

neutral_fact_en: [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] commenced a civil action against [COMPANY_A] and twenty-four other defendants. [PERSON_A] was allegedly exposed to defendants' respective [PRODUCT_A] while working as a machinist with [COMPANY_C] from 1947 until 1979. [PERSON_A] allegedly sustained pleural effusion and parenchymal scarring. [PERSON_A] allegedly sustained pleural effusion and parenchymal scarring as a result of the alleged exposure to [PRODUCT_A]. [COMPANY_A] is a business corporation and a manufacturer of beverage cans. [COMPANY_A] purchased a majority of the stock of [COMPANY_B] in November 1963. [COMPANY_B] had a division that made, sold and installed [PRODUCT_B]. [COMPANY_A] never operated the [PRODUCT_B] division and sold it 90 days after acquiring [COMPANY_B]'s stock. [COMPANY_A] acquired all of [COMPANY_B]'s stock and merged with [COMPANY_B] on February 10, 1996. [COMPANY_A] was sued in asbestos-related cases solely as a successor to [COMPANY_B]. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] sought payment from [COMPANY_A] for losses allegedly sustained as a result of [PERSON_A]'s exposure to [PRODUCT_A] that [COMPANY_A]'s merger partner manufactured and sold. neutral_fact_source: In 1995, [PERSON_C], a financial advisor for [COMPANY_A], initiated an unsolicited telephone contact with [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] and asked to meet regarding their finances. [PERSON_A] told [PERSON_C] that he had a long-term disability policy, and [PERSON_C] reviewed the policy at a later meeting and advised them to keep it because he could not offer a comparable product. In December 1995, for a fee, [PERSON_C] presented [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] with a financial management proposal that identified him as their financial advisor and stated that, at their request, he could recommend products distributed by [COMPANY_D] and its affiliates as alternatives for existing securities. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] provided [PERSON_C] with information about their existing policies with [COMPANY_B]. [PERSON_C] proposed one [PRODUCT_A] in January 1996 and another in June 1996. The June proposal included coverage for [PERSON_A] and a rider for [PERSON_B]. [PERSON_A] purchased that policy and cashed out his five existing policies to make the initial payment. In 1997, [PERSON_B] used proceeds from her two policies with [COMPANY_B] to purchase a [PRODUCT_B]. In 1998, [PERSON_C] proposed increasing [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B]'s life insurance coverage, but they rejected the proposal because they decided that they had enough coverage. In 2000, they had their portfolio independently reviewed. The independent review informed [PERSON_A] that the 1996 [PRODUCT_A] was underfunded and expected to lapse, requiring additional premiums at substantially high rates that would increase over time. The review also informed [PERSON_B] that the 1997 [PRODUCT_B] would not mature until she was eighty-four rather than sixty-five, as had allegedly been represented by [PERSON_C]. The review linked the underfunding of the 1996 [PRODUCT_A] with its expected lapse and the need for additional premiums at rates increasing over time. The policy illustration presented separate current and guaranteed interest-rate columns and stated that there would be no surrender value at age eighty-two. [PERSON_A] signed a disclosure stating that current interest rates were not a prediction of future policy performance. [PERSON_A] testified that [PERSON_C] represented that the monthly premiums would be [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] for eight years, after which the policy would be paid off. [PERSON_B] testified that they often signed documents based on [PERSON_C]'s representations about their contents and that she treated him as her advisor and relied on his word. [PERSON_A] testified that they trusted [PERSON_C] because they believed he knew what was best. [PERSON_A] testified that he had graduated from high school; [PERSON_B]'s educational background was not stated in her testimony. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] allege that [COMPANY_C] and [PERSON_C] presented themselves as experts in financial and retirement planning, while they had only high school educations and no experience working with a financial advisor. They allege that they reasonably believed and trusted that [PERSON_C] prepared the proposal and recommended the 1996 [PRODUCT_A] with their best interests in mind. [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] accepted [PERSON_C]'s advice regarding the purchase of the 1996 [PRODUCT_A] and made the decision to purchase it. They also rejected other products and services. Their business relationship with [PERSON_C], initiated by an unsolicited call, lasted a little more than a year before that purchase. Before purchasing the 1996 [PRODUCT_A], [PERSON_A] and [PERSON_B] became comfortable with [PERSON_C]'s expertise. During the relationship, they followed some of his recommendations and rejected others, and they did not transfer decision-making authority to him.

In August 2003, [PERSON_A], through [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C], filed suit against [ORGANIZATION_A] and an attending physician. [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] alleged that conduct by [ORGANIZATION_A] and an attending physician during [PERSON_A]'s care caused [PERSON_A]'s disabilities. The complaint alleged that [PERSON_A] had incurred expenses for physicians, hospitals, paramedical personnel, home care attendance, medications, and other necessary care and treatment, might incur similar expenses in the future, and had permanently impaired earning capacity. Because [PERSON_A] had been receiving medical assistance benefits through [PROGRAM_A], [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] notified [ORGANIZATION_B] of the suit in March 2004, and [ORGANIZATION_B] asserted a claim against any award or settlement for the amount it had spent on [PERSON_A]'s medical care. The parties reached a negotiated settlement, after which [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] filed a petition concerning settlement of [PERSON_A]'s case. On August 31, 2006, the settlement was approved and included the establishment of a special-needs trust for [PERSON_A]. [CURRENCY_AMOUNT_A] of the settlement was set aside pending determination of the amount needed to satisfy [ORGANIZATION_B]'s claim, and the trustee of [PERSON_A]'s special-needs trust was later directed to reimburse [ORGANIZATION_B] that amount for [PERSON_A]'s medical expenses.

neutral_fact_en: [PERSON_A], a two-month-old child, died while under the care of pediatrician [PERSON_D] and staff members of [COMPANY_A], [PERSON_D]’s employer. [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C], the child’s parents, brought [PERSON_A] to [PERSON_D] for multiple visits after his birth and contacted [PERSON_D]’s office seven times during the week before his death. On July 27, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] reported to [PERSON_D] that [PERSON_A] was taking only about 118 milliliters of formula instead of the customary 177 or 207 milliliters, cried after feedings, and had a slight cough. On July 29, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] reported to [COMPANY_A]’s telephone service and later to [PERSON_D] that [PERSON_A] had projectile vomiting, had been fussy for five days, and was tired after feeding. [PERSON_D] considered pyloric stenosis and noted that a barium swallow test might be indicated, but did not order the test after later developments discounted that diagnosis. On July 30, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] reported that [PERSON_A] continued to have a slight cough and had vomited two or three times daily for four or five days. On August 1, they reported that he was fussy, sometimes vomiting, not sleeping, experiencing pain while feeding, and wheezy afterward. [PERSON_D] considered the symptoms consistent with gastroesophageal reflux, prescribed medication for that condition, and immunized [PERSON_A]. On August 2, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] reported that [PERSON_A]’s formula consumption had dropped to about 89 milliliters, that he was fussy, not sleeping, and screaming as if in pain, that he had wet only two diapers, and that he had a temperature of 38.3°C despite receiving Tylenol every four hours. [PERSON_D] considered the symptoms consistent with reactions to the previous day’s immunizations and possible acid-reflux pain. On August 3, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] took [PERSON_A] to [INSTITUTION_A], where [PERSON_E] found him in severe respiratory distress and confirmed that his heart rate was dangerously low. Despite intubation, ventilation, and other supportive measures, [PERSON_A] died during the early morning of August 4. A postmortem examination established that [PERSON_A]’s death was caused by diffuse acute viral myocarditis, a viral infection of the heart muscle. Experts for [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] testified that [PERSON_D] had failed to refer [PERSON_A] for further testing on August 2. Experts for [PERSON_D] and [COMPANY_A] testified that [PERSON_D] had complied with the applicable care requirements because she had chosen an alternate diagnosis that fit the symptoms and made sense. During a discussion of [PERSON_D]’s proposed instruction, counsel for [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] objected that the instruction would not be proper in this case. Counsel for [PERSON_D] asked whether a careless doctor would spend 15 to 20 minutes speaking by telephone with concerned parents, arrange an appointment before the office opened, watch the child eat for an hour, and make an unsolicited follow-up telephone call the next day. Counsel for [PERSON_D] stated that physicians must make decisions when treating patients and argued that [PERSON_D]’s decisions during the August 2 telephone call were reasonable.

neutral_fact_en: [PERSON_A] was the child of [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C]. On July 6, 1994, [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] filed a writ naming numerous physicians and hospitals as defendants. [PERSON_A] was born on July 16, 1992. [PERSON_A] suffered from hypoxia and encephalopathy and contracted Group B Streptococcus. Shortly after [PERSON_A]'s birth, [PERSON_A] suffered from hypoxia and encephalopathy and contracted Group B Streptococcus. After no complaint was filed within the initial deadline or the extended deadline, the defendants took no action. The parents then sought to discontinue [PERSON_A]'s action without prejudice, and the defendants objected, claiming that the dismissal should be with prejudice. [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] alleged that they had difficulty obtaining medical records from various medical providers and therefore filed the writ. [PERSON_B] and [PERSON_C] alleged that, after receiving and forwarding medical records to experts, the experts could reach no conclusions without additional discovery, including many depositions. They also alleged that they could not afford that process and that their counsel could not finance it. In [PERSON_A]'s action, the parents commenced the case by writ, but no complaint was filed. Counsel for the defendants entered appearances, but there was little or no activity beyond requiring the parents to file a complaint. Medical records were sent to the parents' counsel shortly after the action began, and no further discovery occurred. The defendants had been sued and had appearances entered on their behalf, and the court expressed concern about keeping them subject to the action until July 2012.

[PERSON_A]의 절차에서 부모는 소환장으로 사건을 시작했지만, 고소장은 제출되지 않았다. 피고들의 변호인은 출석을 등록했지만, 부모에게 고소장을 제출하도록 요구한 것 외에는 활동이 거의 없거나 전혀 없었다. 절차가 시작된 직후 의료 기록이 부모의 변호인에게 보내졌고, 그 이후 추가적인 증거개시는 이루어지지 않았다. 피고들은 피소되었고 그들을 대신한 출석 등록이 이루어졌으며, 법원은 2012년 7월까지 그들이 해당 절차의 대상인 상태로 남아 있게 하는 것에 우려를 표했다.
